Process: Baker's yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) grown in a fed-batch bioreactor. Biomass concentration x1 and substrate (glucose) concentration x2 are measured every hour, in g/L. The operator sets the dilution rate u1 (1/h) and the substrate concentration in the feed u2 (g/L), both held constant between switches. Three experiments of 20 h with different starting biomass and input profiles. Measurement error is about 5% of the reading plus 0.01 g/L. The growth kinetics are unknown: find the rate law that explains the data.

Fitted candidates (all on the same data, 126 readings):

Candidate C8 (asprey_2000_contois_kinetics eq 18, rate law r = theta1*x2/(theta2*x1 + x2)):
asprey_2000_monod_kinetics + asprey_2000_contois_kinetics eq 18: chi2 710.5 vs limit 148.8 (LACK OF FIT); AIC 718.5; probability 0.000
   theta1   0.3705  95% CI [0.3588, 0.3822]  t 31.74
   theta2   0.01951  95% CI [0.01832, 0.0207]  t 16.40
   theta3   0.6074  95% CI [0.5859, 0.6289]  t 28.28
   theta4   0.08189  95% CI [0.0737, 0.09008]  t 10.00
   misfit mostly in: E3:x2 (chi2 318 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=20 h); E2:x2 (chi2 184 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=5 h); E1:x2 (chi2 109 over 21 readings, model over-predicts on average, worst at t=3 h)

Candidate C9 (asprey_2000_monod_kinetics eq 17, rate law r = theta1*x2/(theta2 + x2)):
asprey_2000_monod_kinetics + asprey_2000_monod_kinetics eq 17: chi2 715.8 vs limit 148.8 (LACK OF FIT); AIC 723.8; probability 0.000
   theta1   0.3489  95% CI [0.3398, 0.358]  t 38.39
   theta2   0.1122  95% CI [0.1054, 0.119]  t 16.46
   theta3   0.5356  95% CI [0.5199, 0.5514]  t 34.02
   theta4   0.06645  95% CI [0.06019, 0.07271]  t 10.62
   misfit mostly in: E3:x2 (chi2 348 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=20 h); E2:x2 (chi2 159 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=4 h); E2:x1 (chi2 79 over 21 readings, model under-predicts on average, worst at t=14 h)

Candidate C40 (zentou_2019_andrews eq 5, rate law r = mumax*x2/(KS + x2 + x2**2/Ki)):
asprey_2000_monod_kinetics + zentou_2019_andrews eq 5: chi2 112.4 vs limit 147.7 (fits within the noise); AIC 122.4; probability 1.000

   ! only 3 of 4 starting points reached this fit: other starts stopped at worse local optima

Round 1 of 3. Decide. If you accept, 'chosen' is the candidate label, e.g. C8.

answer.feedback: The Monod and Contois candidates substantially underpredict substrate x2 in E2 and E3, while Contois overpredicts x2 early in E1. This points to kinetics beyond these simple rate laws; explore substrate-dependent inhibition (as in Andrews) or a related mechanism, while seeking a formulation whose inhibition and saturation parameters can be identified separately. C40 fits, but KS and Ki are too strongly correlated to distinguish from these data.
answer.reasoning: C40 is the only candidate that fits within the chi-square limit, but its KS–Ki correlation of -0.958 means those parameters are not separately identifiable, so it does not meet the acceptance rule. C8 and C9 both show severe lack of fit.
